one_liner: 30-minute workshop that teaches math faculty with no web experience to build and deploy an interactive course app.
problem: Instructors want interactive teaching tools but lack web-development skills.
approach: I wrote an instructor-led walkthrough of a reference app in five steps, then tiered lab shells (guided, statistics dashboard, open challenge), deployment to Streamlit Cloud, and a quick-reference sheet.
decision_relevance: Builds analytic capacity in others: colleagues leave able to field their own tools.

headline_results.claim: A 30-minute workshop that takes math faculty with no web experience to a deployed Streamlit app
Three-part structure with guided, intermediate and challenge variants of each lab
Authored and maintained in the department org repository

limitations: Stale line-number map in the app header
Lab shells deliberately do not run until the blanks are filled
blockers_before_featuring: Push branch statistics-fixes and open a PR to the usma-stats organization
Archive demo_facdev or point it at the org repo
